query: oracle:"When you cast this spell, " (game:paper) prefer:best
fixes: generic control-next-turn (during_that_players_next_turn + preface rename off Emrakul)
World Anew-style all creatures target player controls gain_control

fixes.title: Any-player-may tax windows
fixes.detail: Generic any_player_may (life/half-life/discard/sacrifice) + APNAP prompts; Brain Gorgers / Dash Hopes / Temporal Extortion / Phantasmagorian.

fixes.title: Targeted gain-control on-cast
fixes.detail: Obligator compound rider repair; Flayer/Beast transfer; Taskmaster for-each-opponent maxTargets.

fixes.title: Mutated Cultist remove-counters cost-reduce
fixes.detail: remove-all-counters + next-spell cost reduce for counters removed this way.

create_tokens.gap_notes: Token creation generally IR/legacy wired; X-from-mana-spent (Prossh/Abby) and processor-style optional payment gates are higher risk.

gain_life.gap_notes: Simple gain-life OK; Breaker-of-Creation for-each and Hydroid Krasis half-X are value-expression sensitive.

return_from_graveyard.gap_notes: On-cast path uses inferTriggeredAbilityTargetMetadata (GY zone/destination). Artisan-class fix already landed; Bruna Angel-or-Human OR matching fixed in resolution.

sacrifice.gap_notes: Bearer optional pay->opponent sacrifice wired via generic pay/If-you-do path. Mana Vortex uses generic unless_sacrifices. Brain Gorgers uses generic any_player_may sacrifice payment window.

copy_spell_or_permanent.gap_notes: Spell-copy stack IR exists; creature token-copy and conditional copies (Sage/Bygone/Malicious) vary.

search_library.gap_notes: Conduit of Ruin / Sowing Mycospawn use library search infra; optional + put-on-top vs put-onto-battlefield differ.

any_player_may_tax.gap_notes: Generic any_player_may IR + server OPTION_CHOICE APNAP window covers Dash Hopes / Temporal Extortion / Phantasmagorian / Brain Gorgers (life / half-life / discard / sacrifice).

pump.gap_notes: Decimator mass pump until EOT is a common continuous-effect pattern under IR.

discard.gap_notes: Distended Mindbender reveal+dual CMV choose-from-it discard repaired (no grant_static). Depth Defiler kickerChooseBoth + then-discard who fixed. Phantasmagorian on-cast tax uses generic any_player_may discard window.

exile_target_permanent.gap_notes: Detection + targeting metadata improved (compound type for World Breaker; up-to-N for Ugin). Effect execution via oracle IR exile steps likely, but colored-permanent / rider clauses (Thief of Existence) need playtest.

commander_cast_copy.gap_notes: Hatut commander-CZ copy path recently fixed (tax/2 + stack copies). Other *Storm commander-copy spells share the pattern but need retest per card.

tap.gap_notes: up-to-N min/max now inferred (Elder Deep-Fiend, Supernatural Rescue). Stun-counter riders (Petrifying/Twisted) need counter placement verification.

gain_control.gap_notes: Targeted gain-control (Obligator/Flayer/Beast) prompts + until-EOT transfer via repaired gain_control steps. Hideous Taskmaster for-each-opponent sets multi maxTargets. Promised End / World Anew remain on generic control-next-turn / bulk handlers.

extra_turn.gap_notes: Emrakul Aeons Torn shorthand remains. Promised End uses generic control-next-turn + take_extra_turn after-that-turn parse.

put_onto_battlefield.gap_notes: Library/reveal-into-battlefield patterns (Genesis Hydra, Hatchery Spider, Oblivion Sower) are multi-step.

draw.gap_notes: Queued on cast; Kozilek draw-four covered by eldrazi-cast-trigger-resolution.integration.test.ts + oracle IR draw steps.

counter_related.gap_notes: Hope-Ender Coatl counter-target may work; Mana Vortex counter-unless-sacrifice is IR unknown.

put_on_library_top.gap_notes: Non-GY put-on-library sets targetDestination library_top + destinationUsesSelectedCardOwner.

destroy.gap_notes: Ulamog destroy target permanent: detection + target metadata + game-actions action map destroy_target_permanent; integration test present.

remove_counters_cost_reduce.gap_notes: Generic remove-all-counters from up-to-one permanent/opponent + grant_next_spell_cost_reduction deferred via nextSpellCostReduction grants.

exile_library_top.gap_notes: Oblivion Sower / Ulamog Defiler involve multi-step exile + optional put-lands; IR may parse but UX/choice flows are complex.

reveal_library.gap_notes: Reveal-until / put Doctor cards / X creatures patterns are bespoke.

lose_life.gap_notes: Abundant Maw opponent-lose+gain; Scourge kicked half-life needs kicker intervening-if.

put_counters.gap_notes: Stun/takeover counters may need specialized counter handlers.
